This is an excellent set for those just getting into magnetic lashes. The variety is perfect for any occasion, and the bonus eyeliner is a nice touch. I only caution that once you put on the eyeliner let it dry completely. Otherwise it wont stick. Also they stay on well, but when you lift the lashes it sometimes lifts the liner, too.  *Update* added an extra star for waterproof quality!
These have 5 small magnets on the lash itself. The liner and lash adhere well! Tried other brands and they didn’t stay on at all.

reviews.t: Allergic to eyeliner, severe reaction.  BEWARE
reviews.x: I’ve used magnetic lashes for awhile now and never had a reaction to the magnetic eyeliner, but I was severely allergic to this brand.  My eyelids are still pink and  swollen 4 days later.  Please beware if you have sensitive skin.  Do not buy!!!
This set wasn’t up to par with me. The liquid didn’t hold the lashes as well as I had hoped.

I can only ear them for a few hours before they start to come loose.  I like this better than glue because it's easier but when I use my glue unless my eyes water I could sleep in my lashes and wear them the next day if I wanted to because they are on so good.

Not a fan. Even when I cut them they don’t fit my eye shape. Also the lashes are very dramatic and not natural AT ALL. if you are looking for something more natural I would buy a different more expensive product as you do get what you pay for.

HOWEVER, 1 year later, here comes this product.  They have figured it out and perfected it!  I read all comments and reviews before purchasing and discovered all are true.  Here are my lessons:  1st: make sure you apply your mascara before or after applying the magnetic liner.  I didn't do that and ended up pulling the magnetic lashes

I like that there is a variety of lashes to choose from so depending on what ur doing u can chose from simple or dramatic. I would recommend using 2 coats of eyeliner before applying your lashes, and allowing the eyeliner to completely dry before applying lashes. Otherwise, lashes fit great and didnt break my wallet with this purchase. Definitely recommend if you are new to this as I am. My lashes stayed on all day and I could barely feel that they were

reviews.t: Perfect for cheer and easy to apply
reviews.x: My daughter wears lashes for junior high cheer and wanted a quick way to apply them without my help. The liner went on easily her very first time and the lashes attached securely!  Her first performance was a parade in hot weather and they worked great. Removal was easy too and I love that we’re not putting glue on her face anymore. The set included helpful tips so she didn’t have to practice to get it right. Best of all, these lashes are thick and long, just what she wanted.

I love these lashes, it does take time to get used to. I. The first use it felt a little bit ichy, but by the second use it didn't feel ichy (to me). It also took me time to get the hang of putying them on, i think its due to my natural eyelashes because they're already curled up. They also do last a long time on, the longest I've had them on was about 7 hours, but it could have last long. I did cut mines to fit properly.

reviews.t: So cute but eyeliner only lasts hour or less
reviews.x: These are super cute to practice on and great for selfies but I can not wear them out of the house because they fall off.  I apply a generous amount of the eyeliner and let it dry.  They go on with ease and they stick well but then the eyeliner dissolved and they fall out.  They are packaged very nicely and are reusable but again- only for around the house.  I can’t risk them falling off at work

Didn’t work. The magnetic lashes simply don’t stick to the eyeliner much at all. It’s globby and hard to use, stays sticky forever and is hard to dry, then the magnetic lashes don’t stick to it for more than an hour. Becomes a hot mess of globby eyeliner smudging and peeling off and you just look terrible in no time. This is the third one I’ve tried and so far they all don’t work.

I have never been able to apply traditional glue-on lashes. For years I have admired them but I have not been able to wear them because of how difficult they were to put on. After trying these magnetic lashes I am hooked on how easy they are to apply. They look great and I no longer have to wish for glue-on lashes. These are my go-to when I want my lashes to look full and long.

Great set for magnetic lashes. Liner goes on smooth, takes a cpl min to dry then boom eyelashes. I tried em on without any other makeup and tested em. Stayed on with wind driving in the freeway with the windows down. Liner cones off with remover. Otherwise wears off in a cpl days.. lashes are soft and natural looking. Im wearing the shortest set in this pic.. Great buy!

Absolutely love my lashes. I was skeptical at first because I had never used lashes with magnetic eyeliner but it turned out great! I just applied the eye liner, let it dry and it immediately went on and I didn't have to re apply the lashes multiple times like you would with glue on lashes. My lashes stayed in place all day and I didn't have any issues. 10/10 recommend.

claims.text: Many reviewers love these magnetic lashes, finding them easy to apply and a great alternative to glue.
Reviewers praise the value, noting the set includes multiple lash pairs and bonus eyeliners at a good price.
Several reviewers say the lashes stay on well and adhere properly to the magnetic liner.
Some reviewers report the liner does not hold well, causing lashes to fall off or come loose.
A few reviewers mention problems with fit, stiffness, or quality, and one reports an allergic reaction to the eyeliner.
